traditions.KJV: Go and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian , saying ,

16.english_reference: Thus saith the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel ;

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: Οὕτως εἶπεν Κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ἰσραήλ
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus exercítuum , Deus Israel :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel ;

16.english_reference: Behold , I will bring my words upon this city for evil , and not for good ;

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִי֩ מבי אֶת דְּבָרַ֜ י אֶל הָ עִ֥יר הַ זֹּ֛את לְ רָעָ֖ה וְ לֹ֣א לְ טוֹבָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ φέρω τοὺς λόγους μου ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν ταύτην εἰς κακὰ καὶ οὐκ εἰς ἀγαθά ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego indúcam sermónes meos super civitátem hanc in malum , et non in bonum ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will bring my words upon this city for evil , and not for good ;

16.english_reference: and they shall be [ accomplished ] in that day before thee .

traditions.WLC: וְ הָי֥וּ לְ פָנֶ֖י ךָ בַּ יּ֥וֹם הַ הֽוּא
traditions.VUL: et erunt in conspéctu tuo in die illa .
traditions.KJV: and they shall be [ accomplished ] in that day before thee .

17.english_reference: But I will deliver thee in that day , saith the LORD :

traditions.WLC: וְ הִצַּלְתִּ֥י ךָ בַ יּוֹם הַ ה֖וּא נְאֻם יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ σώσω σε ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ,
traditions.VUL: Et liberábo te in die illa , ait Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: But I will deliver thee in that day , saith the LORD :

17.english_reference: and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou [ art ] afraid .

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֤א תִנָּתֵן֙ בְּ יַ֣ד הָֽ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה יָג֖וֹר מִ פְּנֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐ μὴ δώσω σε εἰς χεῖρας τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὧν σὺ φοβῇ ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: et non tradéris in manus virórum , quos tu formídas :
traditions.KJV: and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou [ art ] afraid .

18.english_reference: For I will surely deliver thee , and thou shalt not fall by the sword ,

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י מַלֵּט֙ אֲמַלֶּטְ ךָ֔ וּ בַ חֶ֖רֶב לֹ֣א תִפֹּ֑ל
traditions.LXX: ὅτι σώζων σώσω σε , καὶ ἐν ῥομφαίᾳ οὐ μὴ πέσῃς ·
traditions.VUL: sed éruens liberábo te , et gládio non cades ,
traditions.KJV: For I will surely deliver thee , and thou shalt not fall by the sword ,

18.english_reference: but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee :

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיְתָ֨ה לְ ךָ֤ נַפְשְׁ ךָ֙ לְ שָׁלָ֔ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ἡ ψυχή σου εἰς εὕρεμα ,
traditions.VUL: sed erit tibi ánima tua in salútem ,
traditions.KJV: but thy life shall be for a prey unto thee :

18.english_reference: because thou hast put thy trust in me , saith the LORD .

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי בָטַ֥חְתָּ בִּ֖ י נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐπεποίθεις ἐπ᾽ ἐμοί , φησὶν Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: quia in me habuísti fidúciam , ait Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: because thou hast put thy trust in me , saith the LORD .
